summary: Join our course on climate change and carbon emissions in the oil and gas sector. Gain insights into sustainable practices and strategies for a greener future.
lede: Climate change and carbon emissions training for oil and gas professionals covers measuring emissions and planning practical reductions. Designed for operational, sustainability, project, risk and finance teams, it connects climate considerations to decisions at asset and business levels. Participants explore Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, assess climate and operational risks, evaluate reduction approaches such as methane leak prevention and electrification, and communicate climate performance transparently.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the oil and gas sector who are committed to integrating climate strategies into their operational and strategic decisions.
audience: Operations and field leaders in oil
Project managers and asset development teams
ESG, sustainability, and corporate responsibility leaders
Financial and investment analysts in the energy
modules: Climate Change in the Global Energy Landscape
Carbon Emissions Basics for Oil and Gas
Understanding Climate Policy and ESG Regulation
Reducing Carbon Emissions in Oil and Gas
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of the oil and gas industry operations. Prior experience in environmental or sustainability roles is beneficial but not required.
